svg.title: ReMe Self-Evolving Memory Loop
svg.desc: Conversations and resources become daily memories and connected long-term knowledge, then return to new tasks through search and proactive discovery.
svg.text: A Memory Loop That Keeps Growing
Conversations & resources → readable memory → long-term knowledge → better thinking
Return to the next conversation, inform new thinking, and create more memory
User-owned Markdown: readable · editable · searchable · interconnected
